source: Linked-table capture: real 0.8.8 UI with generated table and mock figure thumbnails. Five unchanged feature views reuse 0.8.7 captures with generated fixtures, synthetic API responses and an example model catalog. Capture versions, crops and hashes are recorded below; provider speed and accuracy are not measured.
